F7 SHOULD Leader board 
competitive 
ranking system 
Rank and display students on a 
competitive leader board, utilising the 
collection of gems as the positioning 
metric. The leader board should reset 
weekly to maintain a continuously 
competitive environment. Students are 
randomly grouped against other users to 
accommodate students who would not 
like to compete against known peers. 
Additionally, the feature should be opt-in, 
to alleviate stress for uncompetitive 
students, as highlighted by (Daniel, et al., 
2015). 
 
Outcome: Creates a competitive 
environment, enhancing motivation and 
retention, while respecting the needs of 
less competitive students.
